summary: Apollo Asset Backed Credit Company LLC filed an 8-K reporting unregistered private placements of multiple share classes to third-party investors for cash, with final share counts set September 25, 2026. Gross proceeds approximate $30.55 million across Series I and II, at transactional NAVs ranging from $24.80 to $25.81 per share as of August 31, 2026. Sales relied on Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and Regulation S exemptions. The filing also disclosed declared distributions. The offering is a routine private placement under an evergreen structure; there is no board recommendation or advisor and no special-situation transaction to monitor.
